name: February
summary: The other quiet winter month: cold parks run their minimum calendars, the warm-climate parks run walk-on weekdays, and the only crowd bumps are the Presidents' Week window.

verdict.short: February at these parks: a good window with known trade-offs. The other quiet winter month: cold parks run their minimum calendars, the warm-climate parks run walk-on weekdays, and the only crowd bumps are the Presidents' Week window..

peakWindows: Presidents' Week at the Florida parks

cost.note: Ticket prices move by date at every park on this site; the level describes the month's overall shape rather than any single day.

planningNotes.heading: The month in one decision
body: Presidents' Week at the Orlando and SoCal parks is the month's one real crowd event — the rides-shorter lines of January return the week after.

planningNotes.heading: The detail that matters
body: Great America and Great Adventure run weekend-only or closed this month; their seasons start later.

freshness.sourceNote: Crowd and cost shapes describe multi-year patterns across the ten parks rather than a forecast for any single year. Weather figures are climate normals for each region and do not decay; the Texas figures blend the DFW and San Antonio areas, and the Southern California figures blend the coastal and inland valleys.
